name: Kestrel Court
tagline: The command deck for the self-governed community.
positioning: Kestrel Court hands volunteer boards and owner-managers the infrastructure of a professional management firm — governance, dues, and disputes in one orbit.

hero.h1: Run your HOA like an institution, not a group chat.
hero.sub: Kestrel Court replaces the shoebox of receipts, the missed reserve study, and the 40-message email thread with one governed system built for boards who answer to their own neighbors.

features.title: Dues that collect themselves
features.description: Assess, invoice, and reconcile monthly dues with auto-reminders and a homeowner portal. Delinquencies escalate on a schedule you set — no awkward doorstep conversations.

features.title: Reserves you can defend
features.description: Model your 30-year reserve study, tag every roof and retaining wall, and know the exact special-assessment your community faces before the vote, not after.

features.title: Governance on the record
features.description: Motions, seconds, quorum, and minutes captured in a tamper-evident ledger. Every vote produces a signed record your bylaws can stand behind.

features.title: Architectural requests, resolved
features.description: Homeowners submit ARC applications with photos and plans; the board reviews, votes, and issues decisions with an audit trail attached to the lot.

features.title: Violations without the drama
features.description: Log a fence complaint, attach evidence, and send templated notices that follow your CC&Rs and state cure periods to the letter.

features.title: One source of neighborly truth
features.description: Owner directory, documents, calendar, and open work orders in a single portal every resident can actually find and use.

testimonials.quote: We self-managed 84 units on spreadsheets and prayer. Kestrel Court gave us a reserve study we could actually explain at the annual meeting — the special assessment passed without a single shouting match.
testimonials.name: Diane Vollmer

testimonials.quote: The violation notices used to take me a Saturday. Now the CC&R clause auto-populates and the cure period is calculated for me. I got my weekends back and our attorney stopped correcting my letters.
testimonials.name: Marcus Reyes

testimonials.quote: I manage six small associations solo. The tamper-evident vote ledger alone is worth it — when an owner disputes a decision, I send them the signed record and the conversation ends.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

homepage.footerBlurb: Kestrel Court is the governance infrastructure for communities that govern themselves. Built for boards, owners, and the neighbors who trust them.
